name: Teammates v5 (rounds)
about: collector_v5's 30 items with the same labels: 23 gestures + 4 short idles in random rounds (each once per round, 3 s window), then 3 x 60 s idle. Converts to the v5 CSV with app_to_v5_csv.py. About 3.5 min per round.

motions.instruction: Quick double head tilt to the LEFT (ear to shoulder)
motions.how: left ear toward left shoulder and back, twice, quickly

motions.instruction: Quick double head tilt to the RIGHT (ear to shoulder)
motions.how: right ear toward right shoulder and back, twice, quickly

motions.instruction: Quick double nod FORWARD
motions.how: chin down and back up, twice, quickly

motions.instruction: One brisk head circle CLOCKWISE (~2 s)
motions.how: nose draws one clock on the wall: 12, 3, 6, 9, 12

motions.instruction: One brisk head circle COUNTER-CLOCKWISE (~2 s)
motions.how: nose draws one clock backwards: 12, 9, 6, 3, 12

motions.instruction: Turn head LEFT, then dip chin down
motions.how: look left, dip the chin once, come back to the front

motions.instruction: Turn head RIGHT, then dip chin down
motions.how: look right, dip the chin once, come back to the front

motions.instruction: Open mouth wide twice (head still)
motions.how: open wide and close, twice

motions.instruction: Puff both cheeks twice (head still)
motions.how: fill both cheeks with air and release, twice

motions.instruction: Slide jaw LEFT, then RIGHT, back to centre
motions.how: lower jaw slides left, then right, then centre

motions.instruction: Closed-mouth smile, both sides, twice
motions.how: lips closed, both corners up, twice

motions.instruction: Tap back teeth together twice (quick, firm)
motions.how: back teeth click together twice

motions.instruction: Push lower jaw FORWARD twice
motions.how: push the lower jaw out and back, twice

motions.instruction: Clench back teeth firmly twice
motions.how: bite down hard for a moment, twice

motions.instruction: Raise eyebrows and lower them, twice (head still)
motions.how: eyebrows up and down, twice

motions.instruction: Eyebrows up-down ONCE, pause ~1 s, open mouth wide ONCE
motions.how: eyebrows once, wait one second, mouth once

motions.instruction: Open mouth wide ONCE, pause ~1 s, eyebrows up-down ONCE
motions.how: mouth once, wait one second, eyebrows once

motions.instruction: Eyebrows up-down ONCE, pause ~1 s, puff cheeks ONCE
motions.how: eyebrows once, wait one second, puff once

motions.instruction: Open mouth wide ONCE, pause ~1 s, puff cheeks ONCE
motions.how: mouth once, wait one second, puff once

motions.instruction: Puff cheeks ONCE, pause ~1 s, eyebrows up-down ONCE
motions.how: puff once, wait one second, eyebrows once

motions.instruction: Slide jaw LEFT and back ONCE, pause ~1 s, eyebrows up-down ONCE
motions.how: jaw left and back, wait one second, eyebrows once

motions.instruction: Eyebrows up-down ONCE, pause ~1 s, slide jaw LEFT and back ONCE
motions.how: eyebrows once, wait one second, jaw left and back

motions.instruction: Slide jaw firmly RIGHT, hold briefly, back; pause ~1 s; eyebrows up-down ONCE
motions.how: jaw right, hold, back; wait one second; eyebrows once

motions.instruction: Sit still, breathe normally
motions.how: relax, look ahead

motions.instruction: Talk naturally (count aloud, read something)
motions.how: count aloud until the beep

motions.instruction: Chew (gum or pretend)
motions.how: chew normally until the beep

motions.instruction: Swallow ONCE, otherwise still
motions.how: one normal swallow

activities.text: SIT STILL: sit relaxed and still, look at the screen
TALK: talk naturally the whole time (read aloud, chat)
CHEW: chew gum (or pretend) the whole time
